extension_of: PREREG.json and CONFIRM_PREREG.json (both unchanged). This is a disclosed extension, not a replacement.
why: Independent verification (round 1) showed that c3d96b04 dropped the ended session's element tokens only when the call that noticed the ended session itself carried element_token. When a token-free call (type_text, key, coordinate click) noticed it, Hermes revived, replayed that call and kept the dead tokens, and the next element action sent one (REAL probe: Driver refused 'element_token is stale ... pid has no current snapshot'). Fix d39e1175f36ab0dcdc552c2eb128f30efdfa4a1f: the transport-reset callback runs on every ended-session result before the revive, so tokens and target are dropped whichever call noticed the end. Unit red (c3d96b04 + new tests: 2 failed) / green (16/16; computer_use suites 310 passed, 0 failed) and a REAL probe for three triggers (element click, type_text, key) on c3d96b04 and d39e1175 were run before this set.
